title: [Hierarchical Menu] Widget does not inform if the item has children
body:
The widget does not inform when one of it's item have children. This can be very useful on many types of filters and is a big problem for a page where I implemented it today.

If anyone knows a workaround solution for this, I would love to know how you did it.

comments.body:
Hi @norok thanks for reporting this. Indeed that would be a nice addition, would you like to contribute?

Have a look at how the underlying React component is doing it: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/master/src/components/RefinementList/RefinementList.js

Maybe @wundo?

Otherwise, we are taking your request into account and should add it as soon as possible
